question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **imbalance**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Imbalance **means a lack of balance, disproportion, or an uneven distribution of elements. (असंतुलन)

 
 
• **Example**: *The excessive workload created an imbalance in her life, causing stress and affecting her overall well-being.*
